summary: Stage 1 done: the root is his own statement. He answered all three asks of turn 1 (OWNER:1795755622961436106, 1795755647483442186, 1795755673273656447); all three are cited in record.json and written word for word in log.md. a_root: he typed his statement of the mod and allowed a rephrasing; record.json root holds his words, the rephrased text and each wording that is not his. The mod changes specified machines that install like furniture into ancient machines that a colony can no longer research and build; a colony finds one, brings it to a safe place, studies it to open its research, and repairs it through Wrecked (does not work), Kludged (minimal) and Refurbished (full function, slower); the Original is for comparison only; each repair needs study, bench time and resources, and the last needs a rare Ancient Component; 0.1.0 supports only the factory mod and some vanilla items (power supply, psychic emitter). a_how_found: ruins, plus a rare wreck on an ordinary map (by card). a_riders: he called the ask confounded and answered per thing: the forge's order is the Utinni tier's decision, the distillation machine is FlowWorks'; the Designer's call d_riders_fate puts all three rules outside 0.1.0's bars (the salvage rule on the Designer's own call, since he did not speak of it). A lesson is filed on the confounded ask. A fresh Opus reader (a90c3d35ce434f40d) checked the rephrasing against his words; six wordings that said more than he did were corrected. His statement differs from the built mod in five places, recorded for stage 2 and 3: the smelter wreck cannot be picked up (c_wreck_cannot_be_carried, core); the power-cell wreck gives a faint current (c_wreck_gives_a_trickle, core); only one factory machine is onboarded (c_half_ancient_factory, core, with the draft ask a_which_factory_machines); Kludged needs no study and Refurbished lacks a recipe (build items); a Mod Setting, off as shipped, brings the Original back (one line at stage 3). Resolved: c_factory_mod_required, c_original_means_two_things. The offer of a look at the running mod (turn_01.md) has no answer from him and still stands; stage 2 carries it.
